criteria.title: The reaper never governs a personal desktop

intent.request: A personal desktop is the person's own seat, so agent idle cleanup must not freeze or kill it.

criteria.model: The lifecycle reaper refuses to govern a desktop session whose scope is user.
criteria.bar: The lifecycle reaper refuses to govern a desktop session whose scope is user.
criteria.driftMarkers: The reaper freezes or terminates a scope=user desktop session.

criteria.title: The personal worker runs only as the customer account

intent.request: The personal desktop runs as the customer account so the person's own files and tools are present.

criteria.model: The personal desktop worker refuses to start unless it runs as the customer workspace account.
criteria.bar: The personal desktop worker refuses to start unless it runs as the customer workspace account.
criteria.driftMarkers: The personal desktop worker starts under any other account.

criteria.title: A person has exactly one personal desktop

intent.request: Opening my desktop again returns the same desktop rather than a new one.

criteria.model: Starting a personal desktop twice for the same person returns the same scope=user desktop session.
criteria.bar: Starting a personal desktop twice for the same person returns the same scope=user desktop session.
criteria.driftMarkers: A second start for the same person creates a second desktop session.

criteria.title: Nobody else can open a personal desktop

intent.request: A personal desktop belongs to one person.

criteria.model: Opening another person's personal desktop in watch mode through the hosted session host is refused with desktop_not_owner.
criteria.bar: Opening another person's personal desktop in watch mode through the hosted session host is refused with desktop_not_owner.
criteria.driftMarkers: A non-owner watch channel reaches another person's personal desktop.

criteria.title: My desktop opens in Take control

intent.request: One click from the Desktops tab lands the owner in control of their own desktop.

criteria.model: Clicking My desktop in the hosted Desktops view opens the caller's personal desktop in takeover mode.
criteria.bar: Clicking My desktop in the hosted Desktops view opens the caller's personal desktop in takeover mode.
criteria.driftMarkers: The click opens a different desktop or opens it in watch mode.

criteria.title: It runs as the customer account on a real host

intent.request: Implemented start to finish means shown working on a real machine.

criteria.model: On a real KasmVNC host the personal desktop X server process runs under the customer account uid.
criteria.bar: On a real KasmVNC host the personal desktop X server process runs under the customer account uid.
requiredScope: pack install on a real host
criteria.method: Live run on a real KasmVNC host with the desktop pack installed, running workspace-host runtime 0.0.21-pcd006b (live-run.json records the runtime version and host id): compare the uid of the personal desktop X server process (ps -o uid= -p <Xvnc pid>) with id -u papercusp-workspace. Live-plane provenance is MANUAL: the run is committed as docs/evidence/personal-cloud-desktop-2026-10-06/live-run.json (assertion personal-desktop-uid), recorded with testing:record-run, and posted on the P-006 work-item. The maintained real-host e2e suite executes this same observation through the production relay, with a distinct per-bar case and runtime-measured e2e layer. Clean committed test-run lineage accompanies the immutable observation artifact; historical manual evidence stays archived. Reconnect identity is derived from a newly received request-correlated owner roster, with receipt time, and the Xvnc PID is independently re-read.
criteria.driftMarkers: The live personal desktop X server runs under another uid or fails to start.

criteria.title: The personal desktop is documented

intent.request: Finishing the feature includes documenting it for the next agent.

criteria.model: The repository docs projection contains an agent-insights doc for the personal cloud desktop that names the account it runs as.
criteria.bar: The repository docs projection contains an agent-insights doc for the personal cloud desktop that names the account it runs as.
criteria.method: automated tests: the bound test reads the projected agent-insights doc from the tree and asserts it names papercusp-workspace.
criteria.driftMarkers: No agent-insights doc for the personal cloud desktop exists in the docs projection, or it does not name the account it runs as.

criteria.title: Sandbox desktops never reach the personal worker

intent.request: Agent sandboxes must stay isolated from the customer account (D-001).

criteria.model: An agent or pot desktop start provisions through the sandbox socket and never dials the personal worker socket.
criteria.bar: An agent or pot desktop start provisions through the sandbox socket and never dials the personal worker socket.
criteria.driftMarkers: An agent or pot desktop request reaches the personal worker socket.

criteria.title: Personal desktops never use the sandbox worker

intent.request: The personal desktop must run as the customer account, never in the sandbox identity (D-001).

criteria.model: A personal desktop start provisions through the personal worker socket and never dials the sandbox socket.
criteria.bar: A personal desktop start provisions through the personal worker socket and never dials the sandbox socket.
criteria.driftMarkers: A scope=user desktop is provisioned through the sandbox socket.

criteria.title: The owner can watch their personal desktop

intent.request: A person must be able to view their own desktop.

criteria.model: Opening one's own personal desktop in watch mode through the hosted session host is accepted and streams the desktop.
criteria.bar: Opening one's own personal desktop in watch mode through the hosted session host is accepted and streams the desktop.
criteria.driftMarkers: The owner's watch open of their own personal desktop is refused.

criteria.title: The owner can take control of their personal desktop

intent.request: A person must be able to drive their own desktop.

criteria.model: Opening one's own personal desktop in takeover mode through the hosted session host is accepted with the control credential.
criteria.bar: Opening one's own personal desktop in takeover mode through the hosted session host is accepted with the control credential.
criteria.driftMarkers: The owner's takeover open of their own personal desktop is refused or downgraded to watch.

criteria.title: Nobody else can take control of a personal desktop

intent.request: A personal desktop is private to its owner in every viewer mode.

criteria.model: Opening another person's personal desktop in takeover mode through the hosted session host is refused with desktop_not_owner.
criteria.bar: Opening another person's personal desktop in takeover mode through the hosted session host is refused with desktop_not_owner.
criteria.driftMarkers: A non-owner takeover channel reaches another person's personal desktop.

criteria.title: A refused personal-desktop open is audited

intent.request: Refused access to someone's desktop must leave a trace.

criteria.model: A desktop_not_owner refusal emits an operation_denied audit event naming the channel and the refused operation.
criteria.bar: A desktop_not_owner refusal emits an operation_denied audit event naming the channel and the refused operation.
criteria.driftMarkers: A desktop_not_owner refusal produces no audit event.

criteria.title: Rosters hide other people's personal desktops

intent.request: Other members must not see a person's private desktop in the Desktops grid.

criteria.model: The desktop roster returned to person U lists agent and pot desktops but no scope=user desktop owned by anyone other than U.
criteria.bar: The desktop roster returned to person U lists agent and pot desktops but no scope=user desktop owned by anyone other than U.
criteria.driftMarkers: A roster shown to a person includes another person's personal desktop or omits the agent and pot desktops.

criteria.title: A failed My desktop start shows its error

intent.request: A person must learn why their desktop did not open.

criteria.model: When the My desktop start fails, the Desktops view shows the failure code to the person.
criteria.bar: When the My desktop start fails, the Desktops view shows the failure code to the person.
criteria.method: automated tests: the component test includes the personal_desktop_unavailable failure a host without the desktop pack returns.
criteria.driftMarkers: A failed My desktop start leaves a spinner or blank view with no error shown.

criteria.title: My desktop reopens the running desktop

intent.request: Clicking My desktop again must return to the same desktop.

criteria.model: Clicking My desktop while the person's desktop is already running opens that running desktop session.
criteria.bar: Clicking My desktop while the person's desktop is already running opens that running desktop session.
criteria.driftMarkers: Clicking My desktop while a personal desktop runs starts or opens a different desktop session.
